n: The model is the trained system underneath; the app is the window you type into. One model can power a chat window, a phone assistant and a tool inside your spreadsheet, and one app can switch the model behind it. When you compare AI tools, ask which model each one runs and when it last changed, because that is often what changed when the answers did.
